Report page

docs / specs / report-page.spec.html

QA fixture: a spec whose mockup set draws its screens.

User stories

As a manager, I see each team's weekly total at a glance.

As a manager, I export the totals I see.

Acceptance criteria

The report page shows each team as a card with its avatar and its total for the week.

Pressing a team's card opens its team page, listing its totals for the last three weeks.

The onboarding tour points to the team cards first.

The Export CSV button opens the export dialog.

The export dialog lists the rows the CSV holds and downloads weekly-totals-2026-W01.csv.

Behavior

Cards are ordered by the week's total, highest first. Totals come from the weekly totals the report service holds.
